description: Tutto Enhancements: Home and Work shortcut chips with clean Back navigation, and label search suggestions while typing. patches.name: Home and Work shortcuts
patches.description: Adds Home and Work shortcut chips beside Maps' category carousel, with clean Back navigation. Select alongside bearinmind's Offline saved places, which draws saved places, labels and starred places on the map. Built for bearinmind 2.5.5 and Maps 26.36.04.973607363. Does not support Add microG support.

patches.name: Label search suggestions
patches.description: While you type in Maps' search box, shows up to three matching Home, Work and Local saved labels above Google's suggestions (exact, then prefix, then substring; case and accents ignored). Tap one to open the place, or in directions to set the stop being edited. Select alongside bearinmind's Offline saved places. Built for bearinmind 2.5.5 and Maps 26.36.04.973607363. Does not support Add microG support.

release_notes:
Fixes **Label search suggestions** in the directions editor.

Picking a label from "Your labels" while changing the start (or destination) of a route replaced the whole trip with that place. A tapped label is now submitted through Maps' own search box, so it fills only the stop you are editing and keeps the other one. In the main search box, tapping a label still opens the place.

- Patches in this source: **Home and Work shortcuts** and **Label search suggestions**. Select either or both.
- Built for bearinmind **2.5.5** and Maps **26.36.04.973607363**. Leave Add microG support off.
- Patched cleanly with bearinmind 2.5.5 in Morphe Desktop 1.18.1; the directions fix is not yet tested on a device.
